sources.excerpt: Official homepage identifies Chai Wyy at 298 Sunset Park Drive, Herndon, VA 20170 and links the current menu and ordering surface.

Live official ordering menu for 298 Sunset Park Dr enumerates lunch, chaats, sandwiches, Frankies, dinner, Chai Wyy specials, sides, desserts, and nonalcoholic beverages. Ingredient descriptions support only recorded positive allergen signals; absence is not asserted.

Official catering page advertises catering and an embedded downloadable menu, but the embedded PDF failed to load in the retrievable page. Catering is event/custom scope and was not merged into the routine ordering catalog.

Official catering FAQ says the restaurant will make its best attempt to accommodate dietary restrictions, including allergies, and asks customers to call for specific requests; it is not an item allergen matrix or absence claim.
Restaurant-linked Owner/OrderSave app is linked from the official site for ordering; no separate allergen matrix or cross-contact disclosure was exposed.
Official-domain document, sitemap, PDF, nutrition, ingredient, FAQ, image, and downloadable-menu surfaces were inspected; no official allergen matrix was found.
Targeted web searches surfaced the official routine and catering pages but no restaurant-issued allergen matrix.
